gallery.title: File:BEL 1958 MiNr1091 pm B002.jpg
gallery.description:
Stamp of Belgium; 1958; commemorative stamp of the issue "World Exhibition 1958 in Brussels"; stamp motive show a view to the Atomium in Brussels and the exhibition emblem; stamp postmarked in Brussels, 1958
Note:
The "Atomium" is a momument in Laeken near Brussels, erected to the there "World Exhibition 1958". The designer of this monument was the engeneer André Waterkeyn (1917-2005). The construction symbolizes a body-centered cubic crystal structure. Erected was the monument by the architects André and Jean Polak in 1957 at the Heysel-Plateau in Laeken near Brussels.
Stamp: Michel: No. 1091 ; Yvert & Tellier: No. 1008A; Scott: No. 501; AFA: 1108
Color: dark green
Watermark: none
Nominal value: 2 F 50 (= 2.50 Francs)
Postage validity: from 4 February 1958 until ?

Stamp picture size (printed area of a single stamp): 24.5 x 35.5 mm
